cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Chrome 的一份 agent 指引
三天涨到 1 万颗星
cover.dek: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance 此前每天只涨 5 到 15 颗星，近三天逐日升到 +3,549。来源查到了：Show HN 442 分，加上 @ChromiumDev 官方连发。
cover.title_en:
Chrome's guide for agents
hits 10,000 stars in three days
cover.dek_en: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance gained 5 to 15 stars a day until recently, then climbed to +3,549 a day. The source is traceable: a 442-point Show HN plus a run of posts from @ChromiumDev.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: SparseRead 控制 agent 读什么，总 token 最多降 92.9%，97% 的设置下质量不降。
stickers.text_en: SparseRead controls what an agent reads, cutting total tokens by up to 92.9% with no quality loss in 97% of settings.

stickers.title: 新热点
stickers.text: 能操作手机的个人 Agent kuafuai/andee 日增 +911，前几天只有 40 到 100。
stickers.text_en: kuafuai/andee, a personal agent that operates phones, gained +911 stars in a day, up from 40 to 100 earlier this week.

stickers.title: 社区风向
stickers.text: HN 被 Claude 大面积故障占满，status 页那条帖子 417 分、344 条评论。
stickers.text_en: Hacker News was taken over by the Claude outage, with the status page post at 417 points and 344 comments.
